intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Nagpur, Maharashtra. This page compares recorded fees and NIRF ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}, and is honest about the old placement records.

Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management vs VNIT Nagpur is a private college compared with a National Institute of Technology. VNIT has the much higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 44, but neither side has a 2020 or later placement row here.

sections.heading: Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management vs VNIT Nagpur for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose VNIT Nagpur if you can get a JEE Main seat at an NIT and want the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 44. RCOEM's latest NIRF Engineering rank on this page is 146 from 2022.
Do not pick either college on the placement numbers shown here. RCOEM's latest recorded year is 2017 and VNIT's is 2015, so both are too old to treat as current outcomes.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹1.39 lakh and tuition of ₹1.19 lakh a year for RCOEM. Treat these as recorded year fees, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the college's official circular and your MHT-CET quota.

VNIT Nagpur has recorded tuition of ₹1.25 lakh a year. That is in line with the usual NIT statutory tuition for General and OBC students, with remissions and waivers published by the institute. Confirm VNIT's current official fee notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: RCOEM's latest recorded row here is from 2017, with a highest package of ₹20 lakh and no usable average in that record. Because 2017 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.

VNIT's latest recorded row is from 2015, with an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. That is also older than 2020. Ask both institutes for their latest official placement reports, and do not compare 2015 with 2017 as if they described today's market.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: VNIT Nagpur admits undergraduate students through JEE Main and JoSAA or CSAB counselling, as a National Institute of Technology.
RCOEM lists JEE Main and Maharashtra CET on this page. Most of its state seats go through MHT-CET counselling. A MHT-CET rank is not a route into VNIT.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Nagpur, Maharashtra. VNIT is a central government NIT campus. RCOEM is a private engineering college in the same city.
If you already plan to stay in Nagpur, the choice is about the entrance test and the NIRF standing, not a change of city. Visit both if commute and hostel life matter.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you have a JEE Main rank that can get an NIT seat, VNIT Nagpur is the stronger official name on this page, with a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 44.
If you are in the MHT-CET pool, RCOEM is the relevant campus here. Ask it for a current placement report, because this page only holds a 2017 row.
Do not decide on the pre-2020 packages shown in the detailed table. Use each official fee and placement notice.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, RCOEM or VNIT Nagpur, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: VNIT is an NIT with a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 44 and a JEE Main route. RCOEM is a private Nagpur college with a 2022 NIRF Engineering rank of 146 and MHT-CET plus JEE Main routes. This page has no 2020 or later placement record for either side.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for RCOEM vs VNIT?
faqs.answer: Our records list about ₹1.19 lakh to ₹1.39 lakh a year for RCOEM and tuition of ₹1.25 lakh a year for VNIT. Confirm each official circular, including NIT remissions and MHT-CET quota fees.

faqs.question: Which exams do RCOEM and VNIT accept?
faqs.answer: VNIT admits through JEE Main and JoSAA or CSAB. RCOEM lists JEE Main and Maharashtra CET. A MHT-CET rank is not enough for VNIT.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for RCOEM and VNIT?
faqs.answer: This page does not have a current flagship placement for either side. RCOEM's latest recorded year is 2017. VNIT's is 2015. Ask both institutes for their latest official reports.

faqs.question: Are RCOEM and VNIT in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Nagpur, Maharashtra, on different campuses. VNIT is the NIT campus. RCOEM is a private engineering college.
